cards.text: All the people of Judah take Uzziah, son of King Amaziah, and make him king in his father's place. He's SIXTEEN, friend. Sixteen and running a kingdom, and I still can't run an oven timer without burning a batch.

After his father Amaziah rests with his fathers, Uzziah rebuilds Eloth and restores it to Judah. This king is out here rebuilding whole towns, and I once lost a fight to a cookie box lid. The LID WON, friend.

cards.question: Sixteen-year-old Uzziah sits on the throne in Jerusalem. He reigns for ___ years.
True or false: young King Uzziah does what is right in the eyes of the LORD, just as his father Amaziah had done.

cards.text: And this young king doesn't figure it all out alone. He seeks God all through the days of a man named Zechariah.

cards.question: Uzziah seeks God all through the days of Zechariah. What does Zechariah do for the young king?

answers.text: Instructs him in the fear of God
Leads his army into every battle
Guards the treasury of the temple

cards.question: Here's the line this whole story hangs on. As long as Uzziah sought the LORD, God gave him ___.

cards.text: Uzziah goes to war against the Philistines and tears down the walls of Gath, Jabneh and Ashdod. That's not a battle, friend, that's a DEMOLITION CREW.

cards.question: After tearing down those Philistine walls, Uzziah ___ cities near Ashdod and among the Philistines.
True or false: Uzziah beats the Philistines, the Arabs in Gur-baal and the Meunites on his own strength alone.

cards.text: The Ammonites start bringing tribute to Uzziah. Meanwhile, word about this king is traveling, and I mean TRAVELING.

cards.question: Uzziah has become exceedingly powerful. How far does his fame spread?

answers.text: As far as the border of Egypt
As far as the land of Assyria
As far as the island of Cyprus

cards.text: Then Uzziah builds towers in Jerusalem and out in the desert, digs cisterns, keeps farmers working the land because he's a lover of the soil, and gears up a huge army trained for war. Back in the junk drawer, my whole army was two rubber bands and a dead battery.

cards.question: Back in Jerusalem, Uzziah puts skillfully designed devices on the towers and corners. What are they built to do?

answers.text: Shoot arrows and catapult large stones
Pour hot oil down on attackers
Flash signals to the army far away

cards.question: Uzziah's fame spreads far and wide. Friend, think back to every battle he's fought. How does this king get SO powerful?

answers.text: He took gold from the temple

cards.text: But here's the turn, friend. When Uzziah becomes powerful, his arrogance leads to his own destruction, and he walks right into the temple of the LORD.

cards.question: King Uzziah walks right into the temple of the LORD. What is he there to do?

answers.text: Burn incense on the altar himself
Pray for the priests serving there
Bring a gift of gold for the temple

cards.text: Then Azariah the priest goes in after the king. And he does NOT come by himself.

cards.question: Azariah the priest goes into the temple after King Uzziah, along with ___ brave priests of the LORD.

cards.text: They take their stand right in front of King Uzziah. One king, one altar, and a WHOLE ROOM of priests saying not today.

cards.question: The priests tell Uzziah he has no right to offer incense to the LORD. Only the ___ of Aaron are consecrated to burn incense.
True or false: the priests tell Uzziah he will still receive honor from the LORD God for this.

cards.text: The priests tell him to leave the sanctuary, but Uzziah, censer in hand, is ENRAGED and raging at them right in the house of the LORD. Friend, when eighty priests tell you to leave, you LEAVE.

cards.question: While King Uzziah rages at the priests before the altar of incense, something breaks out on his forehead. What is it?

cards.text: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests turn and look at the king. And there it is, right on his forehead.

cards.question: The priests see the leprosy on Uzziah's forehead and rush him out of the temple. What does Uzziah himself do?

answers.text: He grabs hold of the altar

cards.question: True or false: Uzziah hurries out of the temple because the LORD had afflicted him.

cards.text: So King Uzziah is a leper until the day of his death, living in isolation, cut off from the house of the LORD. The man who walked in where he had no right to be... now can't walk in at all.

cards.question: With King Uzziah living in isolation, who has charge of the royal palace and governs the people of the land?

cards.text: The rest of Uzziah's acts, from beginning to end, were recorded by the prophet Isaiah son of Amoz. A PROPHET kept this king's records. Me? The only record anybody ever kept on me was a price sticker that said 25 cents.

cards.question: Uzziah is buried near his fathers in a field of burial that belonged to the kings, because the people said he was a ___.

cards.text: And his son Jotham reigns in his place. Friend, all those towers, and not one of them could keep the pride out.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
